single_method_lane.title: Potential-Field Gradient-Tensor Source Dimensionality (quasi-2D step-source shape index) with cross-field strike agreement, scale persistence and incumbent-proximity novelty allocation
single_method_lane.mechanism: For GeoDAWN B02 rtp, B13 iso_grav_anom and B15 depth_to_base_surf, Gaussian-derivative structure tensors J = G*grad(F)grad(F)^T and Hessians at sigma = 2 and 5 px. Closed-form 2x2 eigenvalues give linearity L = (lam1-lam2)/(lam1+lam2) (~1 for an elongated quasi-2D step source such as a buried faulted basement contact, ~0 for equant 3-D bodies), energetic step score S = L * E, cross-field axial strike agreement cos(2*dtheta), sigma5/sigma2 scale persistence (deep fault steps persist; shallow volcanic texture decays), an explicit equant-source mimic channel (1-L)*E, and a cover-gated joint score (strong subsurface step, weak surface slope B19). GTD-14 channels are strictly zero-catalogue (existing_faults.tif / grid.catalogue never read in feature construction) and are appended to the cached PHYS-44 + HGVC-20 + BPWD PSGV-20 stacks inside the identical dual-expectation LightGBM specialists, distance-adaptive tri-specialist Log-Odds PoE and exact Dinkelbach allocator as H88-BPWD, so the paired same-fold contrast isolates the GTD marginal contribution. Production additionally applies a preregistered incumbent-proximity discount w = 0.55 + 0.45*clip(d/3px,0,1) versus shipped BPWD+HGVC+H33 dots (fold-fair analogue in holdout: versus that fold's BPWD-control dots) to keep the emission in its own lane instead of reselecting incumbent crests (the IR-88-127 / IR-88-249E-02 failure mode).
named_non_fault_mimics: Laterally persistent unfaulted lithologic contact / stratigraphic pinch-out or dike swarm: elongated and step-like in potential fields without brittle offset; mitigated by requiring coincident B15 basement-depth step + cross-field agreement and by the supervised visible-fault contrast
Equant 3-D pluton roofs and volcanic centers: high gradient energy but L ~ 0; explicitly encoded as gtd_mimic_equant_energy so the learner can discount them
Airborne flight-line striping / micro-levelling corrugation: single-azimuth, single-scale linearity; mitigated by sigma5/sigma2 persistence and multi-field agreement requirements

experiments.description: Zero-catalogue specialist: 36 X_phys_diff + 20 PSGV-20 + 20 HGVC-20 + 14 GTD-14 = 90 zero-catalogue channels, LGBM dual-expectation
Identical architecture to H88-BPWD Exp03 (tri-specialist distance-adaptive Log-Odds PoE + Dinkelbach) with GTD-14 appended to both specialists
Exp02 posteriors + preregistered incumbent-proximity discount allocator (w_min = 0.55 within 3 px of fold BPWD-control dots). This is the production procedure; promotion is judged on this arm.

production_emission_plan.values: binary {0.0, 1.0} float32, nodata=None, all-finite zeros export (no NaN anywhere)

uniqueness_policy.binding: vendor/gems57/uniqueness.py::binding_duplicate_decision_v4 (representation-aware, IR-88-249E-01): |Spearman| <= 0.90 vs every registry raster; forward 3-px dot overlap <= 0.70 vs binary dot-field rasters literally and vs continuous probability surfaces via their top-N (N = candidate dots) emission; byte/pixel identity blocks. Adopted as binding for this lane under the session owner's explicit parallel-run protocol (dot overlap is defined against a registry raster's DOTS; a continuous surface positive on 100% of footprint cells has no dots until emitted) and protocol section 2 (fix a wrong shared tool once in the template and report it).
uniqueness_policy.diagnostic_reported_verbatim: literal v3 decision (binding_duplicate_decision_v3) including the dense 17GEMSDOE witness overlap, which is 1.0 for every nonempty raster including random dots and therefore carries no copying information
uniqueness_policy.checks: surface before placement AND final dots, per protocol section 1

promotion_rule_frozen: OK TO SUBMIT iff ALL hold: (1) shared format validators pass on saved bytes (1 band, finite in [0,1] everywhere, CRS/shape/transform match sample, 0 outside footprint, 0 on catalogue); (2) every single-feature leakage canary symmetric AUC <= 0.90 and quadrant-scramble invariance holds; (3) fingerprint share_le2 == 0 and share_gt25 >= 0.35; (4) pre-placement surface |rho| <= 0.90 and final-dot v4 uniqueness pass across the complete accessible registry; (5) HOLDOUT-DTI of exp03 (production procedure) exceeds the same-fold recomputed H88-BPWD control pooled DTI with paired 95% CI lower bound > 0; (6) submission name/note unique and <= 140 chars. Any failure: verdict negative, file labelled DO-NOT-SUBMIT, 0 weekly slots spent or recommended by the lane (slot use remains the owner's separate action on the portal).
